name: 組織メンバー行の権限・所属アクションメニュー
prompt:
Recreate the supplied crop as a faithful, clean Japanese localization of only the GitHub organization member action popup. The crop is exactly 329 by 172 pixels, a compact 1.913:1 landscape rectangle. Preserve that wide, shallow canvas and use the full frame without margins or surrounding screenshot context.

Match the source geometry: the light neutral popup surface begins close to the top and left edges, has subtle cool-gray edging and a soft restrained shadow, and is shown over a uniformly dimmed medium-gray page backdrop. Preserve the narrow dimmed page sliver visible at the far left and the source crop boundary; do not invent readable background text. Keep four compact, evenly spaced, left-aligned text rows with the same inset, line height, weight, and charcoal color as the source. No icons, row dividers, badges, or selected/hovered item.

Use exactly these four Japanese labels, in this order:
「管理」
「ロールを変更…」
「外部コラボレーターに変換…」
「組織から削除…」

All four options remain in the same neutral state. Keep the text crisp and fully readable within the existing popup. Include only this action menu and its dimmed crop background. Do not add the organization member table, avatars, a submenu, the role-change dialog, browser chrome, buttons, or any other content.
reviewNotes: Compared against the exact 329x172 source crop. All four options, their order, neutral state, popup corners, dimmed backdrop, and crop edges are preserved. The first generation used a 328px crop due FFmpeg chroma rounding; the exact 329px crop was then opened and compared, and its added rightmost pixel contains no menu content or geometry change. Candidate 1734x907 preserves the requested aspect ratio within 0.06 percent.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
